title: Grilled Cheese
headnote: I’ll try not to overcomplicate this, but this was Frankenstein's monster of a leftover night that ended up being one of the best meals I’ve ever assembled. A wicked sleeper that, if plated with some rosemary & diligence, would blow any date night out of the water.
yield: DON'T SHARE THIS THEY CAN MAKE THEIR OWN (your words from the future, not mine)

items: Heat your pan to medium-high and toss a healthy dollop of butter onto the pan. Brown it. Melt, froth, foam, and stir like crazy so it doesn't stick or ash.
Rub one side of sliced focaccia with salt and parmesan and lay face down
Same treatment to the other slice and set it on top.
Flip and dance, and don’t spill it everywhere.

notes: I used a beloved panini press, so the pan directions are a little bit of a guess. However, I bet a cast iron treatment would smack.
